what:
F10: the verdicts block. Every criterion value equals the run's own statistic (rounded as the run reports it)
and synthesis_B's published figure where there is one; a change without a declared criterion is reported as
such. In sample the verdicts only check the machinery (the window is 2018-02 .. 2021-12, not the look's).

K1.text: synthesis_B: K1 is adopted only if, on 2022-2025, the sleeve's expectancy per trade with the skip is higher than without and its total R is not lower, both with FP costs and with costs x1.5, and the skipped signals taken alone earn less on average than the kept ones.

criteria.criterion: fp/lab: expectancy per trade with the skip > without
fp/lab: total R with the skip >= without
stress/lab: expectancy per trade with the skip > without
stress/lab: total R with the skip >= without
skipped signals taken alone (FP costs): mean R < that of the kept signals

K2.text: synthesis_B: each new sleeve is adopted only if, with FP costs, PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years, and expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5; and the weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve is at least that of the ten alone. Read beside it, for the robot as it is (not a criterion of the rule): the same sleeve with entry one minute late and every position closed on Friday at 16:50 New York; if that version has expectancy <= 0, the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend.

criteria.criterion: fp/lab: every-signal expectancy (each signal taken alone) > 0
fp/lab: total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years
stress/lab: expectancy per trade > 0 with costs x1.5
fp/lab/sum: weekly mean / sd of R of P0+orb_eth >= that of P0

readings.as_the_live_program_would: not a criterion of the rule: run as the hands would (entry one minute late at market, every position closed on Friday 16:50 New York), FP costs, expectancy +0.3627 R per trade: positive, the robot as it is can carry it

K3.text: synthesis_B: each new sleeve is adopted only if, with FP costs, PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years, and expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5; and the weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve is at least that of the ten alone. Read beside it, for the robot as it is (not a criterion of the rule): the same sleeve with entry one minute late and every position closed on Friday at 16:50 New York; if that version has expectancy <= 0, the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend.

criteria.criterion: fp/lab: every-signal expectancy (each signal taken alone) > 0
fp/lab: total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years
stress/lab: expectancy per trade > 0 with costs x1.5
fp/lab/sum: weekly mean / sd of R of P0+orb_btc >= that of P0

readings.as_the_live_program_would: not a criterion of the rule: run as the hands would (entry one minute late at market, every position closed on Friday 16:50 New York), FP costs, expectancy +0.3326 R per trade: positive, the robot as it is can carry it
